_about: The image slots: label, size limit (MB), largest width or height (px), help, and the modes that can have their own image (email and print logos and the sharing image only have a light one). no_svg lists the slots that can't take SVG, and why.

logo_main.label: Main logo
logo_main.help: Your logo in the site header, beside or instead of the site name. Most sites only need this one: every other logo version uses it when left empty.

logo_stacked.label: Stacked logo
logo_stacked.help: Your symbol above your name, for narrow spaces such as a phone-width header or a sidebar. It only shows where your site's developer has added it to the site's pages. Leave it empty to use the main logo. (For developers: {% theme_logo slot="stacked" %}.)

logo_mark.label: Logo mark
logo_mark.help: Just the symbol, without the name, for tight spots such as an app bar, an avatar or a footer. It only shows where your site's developer has added it to the site's pages. Leave it empty to use the main logo. (For developers: {% theme_logo slot="mark" %}.)

logo_wordmark.label: Wordmark
logo_wordmark.help: Just the name in lettering, without the symbol, for places that already show the symbol. It only shows where your site's developer has added it to the site's pages. Leave it empty to use the main logo. (For developers: {% theme_logo slot="wordmark" %}.)

logo_email.label: Email logo
logo_email.help: For the emails your site sends. Email programs don't show SVG, so use a PNG or JPEG (WebP and GIF don't show in some email programs). Emails have no dark mode, so there's only a light version. It only shows in emails your site's developer has set up to use it. Leave it empty to use the main logo. (For developers: the theme artifacts.)

logo_print.label: Print logo
logo_print.help: A high-resolution version (up to 6000 px) for printed pages, PDFs or invoices. Print has no dark mode, so there's only a light version. It only shows where your site's developer has added it to the site's pages. Leave it empty to use the main logo. (For developers: {% theme_logo slot="print" %}.)

icon.label: Icon
icon.help: One square image (at least 512 × 512 px is best). The browser tab icon, home-screen and app icons are all made from it when you publish.

social.label: Social sharing image
social.help: The picture shown when someone shares a link to your site, in chat apps and social sites. It's cropped to 1200 × 630 from its center. It only shows once your site's developer has added link previews. (For developers: the theme artifacts.)

background_login.label: Login background
background_login.help: A picture behind the login page. It only shows where your site's developer has added it to the site's pages. (For developers: class="capy-bg-login" or the CSS variable --capy-bg-login.)

background_pattern.label: Page background pattern
background_pattern.help: A small image repeated behind pages. It only shows where your site's developer has added it to the site's pages. (For developers: class="capy-bg-pattern" or the CSS variable --capy-bg-pattern.)

no_svg.social: Social sites don't accept SVG for link previews
no_svg.icon: Favicons and app icons are made from it as PNGs
